Bass player here, even bands without bass players (The White Stripes, The Black Keys) have backing tracks with bass or a session player. You are very limited in terms of music you can do, unless it is mellow or folky stuff, like this. I think as a rule of thumb, if the song needs drums, it needs a bass too. This may be a stretch, but if you can find an 8-string guitarist, they can play some stuff in the bass range and substitute as the bass guitar (Animals as Leaders does this most of the time, but even they have a bass in some tracks). Keep trying to find a bass player so you aren't limited, post some ads and whatnot, it's worth it.
